# Support Policy

Thank you for using **ACR (Autonomous Code Reviewer)** (`@debdipbhat/acr`)!

This document explains where and how to get help, report problems, and request improvements.

---

## Where to get help

### 1. Documentation and Guides

Before asking for help or opening an issue, please check the following resources:

* **[Project README](../README.md)**: Details installation, CLI commands, configuration options (`.acrrc.json`), AI setup, and programmatic APIs.
* **[npm Package Details](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@debdipbhat/acr)**: Release versions and published tarball information.
* **Built-in Diagnostics**: Run `acr doctor` or `npx @debdipbhat/acr doctor` to check your environment, Node.js version, Git configuration, and API keys.

### 2. GitHub Issues

We use GitHub Issues for bug reports and feature proposals:

* **Bug reports**: If you encounter unexpected behavior or errors, please search existing issues first and then open a report using our [Bug Report Form](https://github.com/Debdip2003/ai-code-reviewer/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml).
* **Feature suggestions**: If you have an idea for an analyzer rule, CLI feature, or provider improvement, please open a request using our [Feature Request Form](https://github.com/Debdip2003/ai-code-reviewer/issues/new?template=feature-request.yml).

👉 **[Browse or Open GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Debdip2003/ai-code-reviewer/issues)**

---

## Guidelines for requesting support

To keep the project organized and helpful for everyone:

* **Search first**: Check existing closed and open issues to see if your question or issue has already been addressed.
* **Stay on topic**: Do not request help or ask unrelated questions on existing issues or pull requests.
* **Provide reproductions**: When reporting a bug, provide a minimal, sanitized reproduction snippet and system details.
* **Protect sensitive data**: Never post API keys (`GROQ_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`), npm credentials, proprietary code, or confidential data in public issues.

---

## Security vulnerabilities

Do **not** use public GitHub issues or discussions to report suspected security vulnerabilities.

Please submit security concerns privately via GitHub Security Advisories:  
👉 **[Report Security Vulnerability Privately](https://github.com/Debdip2003/ai-code-reviewer/security/advisories/new)**

---

## Maintenance and support terms

ACR is an open-source project maintained on a **best-effort basis**:

* Maintainers review issues and pull requests as personal availability and time permit.
* There is no guaranteed response time or service-level agreement (SLA) for free public support.
* Community members are encouraged to help one another by answering questions and contributing fixes.
